purpose: distance-2 co-occurrence, for real-word errors whose deciding evidence lies outside the adjacent window

model.encoding: identical to he_bigrams.bin, so BigramModel loads it unchanged

known_limitations: Wikipedia prose; the register is wrong for phone typing.
Distance-2 pairs are counted ACROSS out-of-lexicon words, unlike the adjacent table, because the gap is what is being modelled.
A pair two apart is weaker evidence than an adjacent one and is not interchangeable with it; the detector weighs them separately.
